reason: The Live blocks throughput rail adds one first-party ES module to each existing homepage loading profile. js/core/throughput.mjs holds the measured-throughput and block-capacity model as DOM-free functions, imported once by the already-loaded Network Health feature and exercised directly by tests/throughput-check.mjs. Folding it into its single consumer would put the model inside 327 KB of DOM-dependent feature code and remove the unit test's ability to import it in Node.

baseline.measurement: local 12-profile x 3-run matrix; passed with no budget errors

release.measurement: local 12-profile x 3-run matrix; sameOriginRequests the only budget error, in all 36 runs

evidence: Comparing the first-run resource path sets per profile, /js/core/throughput.mjs is the only path added and none is removed, on both desktop and mobile. Request counts show no variance: baseline 137/128 and release 138/129 in every one of the 36 runs on each side.
